entities.name: Llora
entities.description: A human Suwwardi-born instructor who defected to Kroog and trained avenger pilots; she died in the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Sanwell
entities.description: One of Llora's newly promoted avenger pilots.

entities.description: One of Llora's newly promoted avenger pilots.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: The leader whose forces attacked Kroog.

entities.name: Traxos

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: The city attacked by Mishra's forces.

entities.name: Suwwardi
entities.description: A tribe of the Fallaji Empire, Llora's origin.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: The devastating attack on Kroog by Mishra's forces.

events.summary: On the day Kroog is attacked, Llora briefs her cadets, pairs them with sword-pattern avengers and directs their initial deployment.
events.quote: Llora was responsible for briefing and organizing her trainees

events.summary: Llora works with Tawnos to coordinate the defenses and orders Sanwell's group to flank the invading dragon engines.
Llora dies in a fiery blast from a dragon engine while defending the city.
events.quote: she perished in a fiery blast from the dragon engine
